title: FCM legacy HTTP/XMPP sending APIs deprecated
summary: Firebase deprecated sending messages with the legacy HTTP and XMPP FCM APIs on June 20, 2023 and directed developers to HTTP v1, with shutdown beginning July 22, 2024.
migration_path: Migrate legacy HTTP/XMPP send requests to the OAuth 2.0-based FCM HTTP v1 endpoint.
user_impact: Legacy server-side sending integrations require migration to HTTP v1 to remain on the supported FCM interface.
notes: The deadline marks shutdown start; no universal completion date is inferred.
